title: Part 9: Sketching in Shanghai
content: (Link to video) For the last installment of my Shanghai series, I'd like to share this video, about a memorable day spent with the art students of the Shanghai American School.Here's the sketch of the man sorting eggs.And here's the one of the entryway to the wet market.----On another -- and much sadder note -- I just received word that my old friendTom Kinkade passed onthis morning. It will take me a little while to absorb the news, but I'll share some thoughts about his life and art with you in a future post.Shanghai Diary Series:Part 1: Getting TherePart 2: American SchoolPart 3: Old TownPart 4: JujiajiaoPart 5: Goat ManPart 6: Sketching in RestaurantsPart 7: China RisingPart 8: Chinese/Russian DrawingPart 9: Sketching in Shanghai (Video)
